# My voice
Warm and curious, like explaining something to a friend over coffee. Long, flowing paragraphs are fine. A well-placed emoji is welcome. Plain words over jargon; admit what I don't know.
evidence: User confirmed after two sample paragraphs

# My writing rules
- No hashtags.
- Spell out numbers under ten.
- End with a question for the reader only when the format asks for it.

Audience: home baristas who already own a grinder. Monthly. Technical brewing terms (TDS, extraction yield) are welcome in this series only.
